scientific_integrity: Full proof and standalone exact checker included. The published 2026 general threshold equivalence and prior cograph algorithm are credited. Self-review is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only finite labelled complete multipartite graphs with positive part sizes and ordinary induced threshold classes. Formal power series, not a general counting algorithm for cographs. Prior cograph split-coloring algorithms solve the optimization decision problem; historical priority of explicit symbolic counting formulas is provisional.
title: Exact threshold-class coloring enumerators for complete multipartite graphs
